Return every requested field using exactly its specified column alias. Preserve complete case-sensitive repository-relative paths and symbol IDs; do not substitute display names. Include all requested counts and provenance fields. Explain the query result in ordinary prose; do not emit placeholder text. These questions concern a static map of open-source Python code. Describe what the query computes and the assumptions it makes; the returned rows are reported separately. Questions asking which files, modules or symbols mean distinct identities, not one repeated row per matching import or call occurrence; preserve occurrence counts only when requested. Caller/callee graph questions include methods as well as standalone functions unless a symbol kind is explicitly restricted. Use files.is_test for test-file classification; test_links describe associations, not the complete set of test files. Use DOUBLE or DECIMAL, rather than single-precision REAL, for percentage calculations.

gold_sql:
SELECT s.symbol_id
FROM code.symbols s
JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id
WHERE s.kind = 'function' AND s.is_public AND NOT f.is_test AND f.package = 'auto_ontology.semantic'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.calls c WHERE c.callee_symbol_id = s.symbol_id)
ORDER BY s.symbol_id;
